title: Symmetric Monotone Functions Are Thresholds
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be invariant under every permutation of its coordinates and monotone in the coordinatewise order. Then there is a real number $a$ such that, for every $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, $f(x)=1$ when $a+\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\ge 0$ and $f(x)=-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is monotone in the coordinatewise order
